capabilities: Update a note's property with the Kanban column name when its card is moved
Customize the property name to update
Toggle notifications when a status changes
Enable debug logging and a test scan of the active board
extras: README notes that cards must contain internal links to notes and suggests using a dataview query (e.g. all notes with status != 'Done') to build cross-board views.
intentEvidence: Alternative I found to this (MetaEdit plugin) was slow and buggy
motivation: The author found MetaEdit, an alternative approach, slow and buggy, and wanted a lightweight plugin that is snappy and just works.
problem: Obsidian Kanban boards don't sync column changes back to the linked notes, so card status and note properties drift apart.

relations.evidence: Alternative I found to this (MetaEdit plugin) was slow and buggy

summary: Kanban workflow helper that automatically writes a Kanban card's column name to the linked note's status property when the card is moved.
